note: Flagged irregularities. Every row links a registered official source. A flag does not block publication; it blocks any claim that depends on the unverified value.

flags.title: Prior claim did not reproduce
flags.detail: A prior desk records that Baltimore still publishes Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley at quarterback after both went on injured reserve. The page read today prints Jacoby Brissett, Joe Fagnano and Kedon Slovis, and the Week 10 report does not list Jackson or Huntley at all.
flags.disposition: The claim is not repeated. The page as served on 2026-11-17 is transcribed.

flags.title: Prior claim did not reproduce
flags.detail: A prior desk records that Washington leaves a depth-chart slot empty. The page read today prints a name in every one of its 29 slots.
flags.disposition: The claim is not repeated. Seattle's two-names-in-one-slot case does reproduce and is published instead.

flags.title: Stale published counts
flags.detail: A prior desk's requirement text cites 254 injury rows and 4 clubs with a 'no injury' section. The live page has 347 rows and 28 club sections; the other 4 clubs were on bye and have no section at all, which is not the same thing.
flags.disposition: Corrected counts published; the discrepancy is recorded rather than silently overwritten.

flags.title: Two injury departments disagree on the same player
flags.detail: The Week 10 report lists Rasheen Ali as a full practice participant with a blank game status. The same week's official roundup says Ali (ankle) was a full participant. Both are dated, and the report and the news item are not the same document.
flags.disposition: Not reconciled. The report value is published and the news value is recorded beside it.

flags.title: Depth chart has no date on 31 of 32 clubs
flags.detail: Only Green Bay prints a date on its chart ('Unofficial, Nov. 10, 2026'). The other five charts read here print none, so a reader cannot tell how old a chart is.
flags.disposition: The printed date is recorded where it exists and left blank where it does not. R59 is marked partial.

flags.title: Houston depth chart is an image
flags.detail: The Houston page prints a heading and then a single image. There is no text row to parse.
flags.disposition: No Houston row is transcribed from the image. The club is excluded from the depth join and listed in the matchup page's limits.

flags.title: Market columns are empty by policy
flags.detail: No registered publisher of NFL prices exists for this use, so every market cell on every page in this desk is blank.
flags.disposition: Published as blank with the reason. No placeholder, no remembered number, no -110 assumption.

flags.title: The registration is retrospective
flags.detail: The pre-registration file was written on 2026-11-17, after weeks 1-9 had been played. It binds the procedure but it cannot bind the data.
flags.disposition: Every page that cites it says so. No prospective claim is made.

flags.title: No player-level prop evidence
flags.detail: The brief asks for prop combinations. No prop line and no prop outcome is in the repository.
flags.disposition: The prop division is closed with a stated gate rather than filled with a proxy.

flags.title: One season only
flags.detail: The corpus is weeks 1-9 of one season. A season-level train/validation/holdout split is impossible.
flags.disposition: The window split is by week and is labelled as such. PG-SEASONS blocks any stronger claim.

flags.title: Announced-starter sweep is 3 of 32
flags.detail: Three dated starter announcements are captured (Seattle, Cleveland, Arizona). The brief asks for an evidence field, which implies a sweep.
flags.disposition: The three are published with their dates; the sweep is logged as unclaimed.

flags.title: Weather and roof not sourced
flags.detail: No forecast feed and no stadium register are captured, so the wind and roof overlay in the brief cannot be built.
flags.disposition: The columns exist, are blank, and carry the gate that blocks them.

flags.title: One fixture has no printed stadium
flags.detail: The Mexico City fixture prints a game label and a country graphic, not a stadium string.
flags.disposition: The venue cell is blank and the fixture is counted in the 12-of-13 figure.

flags.title: Injury report clock time is not published
flags.detail: The publisher does not print a fetch or publication clock time on the report page, so the 'clock time' requirement cannot be met from the page.
flags.disposition: The read date is recorded and the clock cell is explicitly marked 'unpublished by the publisher'.

flags.title: Depth join covers 6 of 32 clubs
flags.detail: This desk read 6 club charts. The other 26 either were not read here or serve an image.
flags.disposition: Every depth-derived count on the availability page says 6 of 32, and 283 of 347 injured players are marked 'not on chart' rather than guessed.
